title: Very cute! Recommended!
text: A not-too-large aquarium but very well-maintained and with many different species; I really appreciated the very immersive and intriguing setting with children in tow. Recommended!

title: I recommend it
text:
Fabulous, the animals are well cared for in the hottest city in Europe, I remind you, it is not easy in terms of maintenance and yet I was blown away by it!

A little thought, however, for the bull shark that lacked space in this aquarium, it was swimming in circles, it was sad to see.

title: Very well maintained aquarium!
text:
Arrived shortly after opening. Purchased senior tickets for a €3 discount from €18 adult fee. The aquarium is quite large & we spent almost 3 hours enjoying all the exhibits. The special exhibit is about sharks and is well done. 
The tanks have electric displays showing the pictures of the fishes, corals, etc., with names in Spanish & English,  and the scientific name, and shows in what part of the world the species lives.

author: Alexia_H

title: A pleasant surprise - an excellent value-for-money aquarium experience
text:
Unlike some other aquariums we have visited in the UK and other countries, the Seville aquarium was in a modern building. It was spotlessly clean, with no pools of water to slip on, or unpleasant smells. The water tanks for the fish and other marine creatures were also spotlessly clean, professionally well-lit, obviously well-maintained and the fish cared for. 
The aquarium is exceptionally well-designed on three levels with gentle slopes joining them together. There was a strong emphasis on educating the visitor with attractive displays (in English as well as Spanish) with lots of information

title: Varied
text:
Seville has an almost inexhaustible number of historic buildings, squares and fountains to offer. Actually everything is beautiful, and yet the inner eye is happy to see something other than "just" old stones.
For us, visiting the aquarium was a very good decision. We spent about three hours there. Presumably, 1.5 to 2 hours are also enough to let all impressions take effect.
